Shei-Var

Overview

Shei-Var is an orc leader in the Sands. He holds Airy as a proposed offering to the Human-Demon that takes his warriors. Zak must first prove himself by taking the wealth of the ogre Utundry, strengthening Shei-Var’s position against rival orcs. The chief then directs him to the Demon and promises Airy’s release. He also permits Eila to help Zak. [1, 2, 3, 4]

The rescue of Airy

Before leaving Gipath, Zak can finish the separate search for Airy, who set out to find the magician herself and impress him. Estera’s vision points to a goblin prison, where Zak finds her granddaughter’s potion bottle and a note leading to Shei-Var. The orc chief intends to give Airy to a frightening armoured human he calls a Demon. Zak offers to remove this threat instead. Shei-Var first demands proof of his strength against the ogre brothers, whose wealth also threatens the chief’s influence. Once Zak defeats the Demon, Shei-Var honours his promise and sends Airy home. The rescue ends with Estera’s gratitude and Airy’s distress that Zak still regards her as a child. [5, 6, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9]
